<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>false</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_2223823_apollo_0_admissions</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Create charge line for adnavced payment</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous) {

    var advanceAmount = parseFloat(
        current.getValue('advance_amount')
    ) || 0;

    // No advance amount, no charge line
    if (advanceAmount <= 0) {
        return;
    }

    // Check duplicate charge line
    var charge = new GlideRecord('x_2223823_apollo_0_charge_line');


    // Create Advance Charge Line
    charge.initialize();

    charge.setValue('hospital', current.getValue('hospital'));
    charge.setValue('patient', current.getValue('patient'));
    charge.setValue('amount', advanceAmount);

    charge.setValue('charge_type', 'advance');
    charge.setValue('status', 'invoiced');

    charge.setValue('invoice', current.getValue('final_invoice'));

    charge.setValue('source_table', 'x_2223823_apollo_0_admissions');
    charge.setValue('source_record', current.getUniqueValue());

    charge.setValue(
        'description',
        'Advance amount recorded during admission'
    );

    charge.insert();

})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>ayush.mangal</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-13 09:47:30</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>9c2bdd1547e49350273a565a516d430c</sys_id><sys_mod_count>7</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Create charge line for adnavced payment</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Apollo-Hospitals" source="x_2223823_apollo_0">87c1422693c89b507b3a7c5efaba1008</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Apollo-Hospitals">87c1422693c89b507b3a7c5efaba1008</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_9c2bdd1547e49350273a565a516d430c</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>ayush.mangal</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-18 07:32:58</sys_updated_on><template/><when>after</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=9c2bdd1547e49350273a565a516d430c"/></record_update>
